about: Every page template, the designed block it follows, and how far its redesign has got. Designed fields (block, basis, spec, status, extra_macros, note) are written by the designers; derived fields (reference, allowed_macros, extends, macros, controls) are regenerated by python scripts/check_design_map.py --write. basis: rule = first assignment by template path, to be confirmed page by page; reviewed = assigned by a designer looking at the page; declared = taken from the page's own design-block marker. Port-map fields (tier, page_type, type_changed, original, frame, charts, inhouse_components, confidence, reason) come from the designers' port map; there persona and components replace the path-rule values, and original is the shadcn original the page follows (reference stays the block's reference).

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.job: See the state of an area at a glance and go to what needs attention.

data-table.title: Data table
data-table.job: Find, filter and act on many records of one kind.

record-detail.title: Record detail
record-detail.job: Read everything about one record, see what it is linked to, and act on it.

form.title: Form
form.job: Create or change one record, with each field labelled above it and errors beside it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.job: Change how the organisation, an integration or an account behaves, one section at a time.

chat.title: Chat
chat.job: Ask a question in words and get a grounded answer with its sources.

board.title: Board
board.job: Arrange and move items on a surface: Kanban columns, the capability map, a diagram canvas.

onboarding.title: Onboarding
onboarding.job: Sign up, sign in and take the first steps, one short screen at a time.

public.title: Public page
public.job: Explain the product, its price and its terms to someone not signed in.

empty-state.title: Empty state
empty-state.job: Say plainly why there is nothing here, or what went wrong, and offer the next step.

pattern_register.P01-page-header: Know where I am and what I can do on this page: title, path back, and the one main action
pattern_register.P02-section-tabs: Switch between sections of one record or one area without leaving the page
pattern_register.P03-data-table: See a list of records, scan it, and open one
pattern_register.P04-filter-search-toolbar: Narrow a list by searching and by a few filters
pattern_register.P05-pagination: Move through a long list a page at a time
pattern_register.P06-bulk-actions: Act on several rows at once (assign, tag, move, delete)
pattern_register.P07-row-actions-menu: Do something to one row (edit, duplicate, archive, delete) without leaving the list
pattern_register.P08-confirm-destructive: Confirm before something that cannot be undone (delete, remove, disconnect, push to an external system)
pattern_register.P09-form-in-dialog: Add or edit a record in a short form without leaving the page
pattern_register.P10-sectioned-form: Fill in a long form in sections (create or edit an application, contract, license, solution)
pattern_register.P11-inline-edit: Change one value in place (name, owner, status, score) without opening a form
pattern_register.P12-stepper-wizard: Work through a fixed sequence of steps (set up a framework, build a programme, run a journey, connect a source)
pattern_register.P13-file-upload: Choose a file and send it
pattern_register.P14-import-with-preview: Bring data in from a file or a system and check it before it is saved
pattern_register.P15-activity-comment-feed: Read what happened on a record and add a comment
pattern_register.P16-settings-section: Change a setting or a connection and be sure it saved
pattern_register.P17-empty-state: See that there is nothing here yet, why, and what to do next
pattern_register.P18-link-two-records: Connect this record to another (map an application to a capability, an ArchiMate element, an APQC process, a vendor)
pattern_register.P19-pick-one-record: Choose one record (an owner, an application, a vendor) from a long list while filling a form or asking a question
pattern_register.P20-inspect-side-panel: Look at a row's details without losing my place in the list
pattern_register.P21-loading-state: See that content is on its way, in the shape it will arrive
pattern_register.P22-toast-feedback: Be told that an action worked, or why it did not, without losing my place
pattern_register.P23-status-badge: Read a status, severity or confidence at a glance
pattern_register.P24-kpi-row: See the three or four numbers that matter at the top of a dashboard
pattern_register.P25-key-value-summary: Read the facts about one record (owner, cost, lifecycle, dates) in one block
pattern_register.P26-error-state: Understand that something failed, why, and how to recover
pattern_register.P27-evidence-line: See where an answer or a number came from (source, confidence, date) and open the source
pattern_register.P28-cited-answer-chat: Ask a question and read a cited answer in the chat
pattern_register.P29-export-share: Take a result out of Entelim (download, copy, share a link)
pattern_register.P30-hierarchy-browse: Browse a hierarchy (capability tree, process tree, organisation tree) and open a node
pattern_register.P31-global-search: Jump to any record or page by name from anywhere
pattern_register.P33-saved-filters: Save and reapply a list view
pattern_register.P34-schedule-picker: Choose when something runs or repeats
